title: sisters_wedding_dress
beats: I wore my sister's wedding dress to try it on alone, three weeks before her wedding, and I ripped the zipper.
It was a hairline tear, hidden under the lace overlay, barely visible unless you looked close.
I didn't tell her. I just... didn't.
I told myself the seamstress would catch it at the final fitting and fix it, no harm done.
The seamstress never got that dress. My sister's future mother-in-law 'surprised' her by having it steamed and delivered straight to the venue.
It ripped wide open during the recessional, in front of two hundred people, right as she turned to walk back down the aisle.
She still doesn't know it was me. She thinks the dress was just old.
Was I wrong to stay quiet, or is it too late now to ever tell her?
